messages:
maria: One-pager sync: prepping launch-readout for Dedicated reserved pools. Want checklist + unique open questions before I hand to sales/SRE.

kenji: Drop the checklist here; I can wire telemetry and billing export.

maria: Core checklist:
- admission + contiguous 5m user-visible bursts
- soft-eviction with 30s warning + structured fallback payload
- burst accounting ledger + daily billing export
- console: active-burst banner, last-7d timeline, recent warnings
- SLO smoke tests and tenant-sim harness for canary

sarah: Runtime caveat: VPU/model cold paths add ~80-150ms p95 on first requests. Recommend prewarm credits or explicit degradation path to fallback_model to keep canary meaningful.

ralph: Ops: require structured event soft_eviction.v2 with tenant_id,pool_id,ts,reason,active_requests:int,fallback_model,operator_override?bool. ops-bot: register?

ops-bot: /event-schema registered: soft_eviction.v2 -> tenant_id,pool_id,ts,reason,active_requests:int,fallback_model,operator_override:bool :white_check_mark:

maria: Billing export schema proposal (daily snapshot):
```
date,tenant_id,pool_id,total_burst_seconds,prewarm_credits_used,eviction_count
```
BigQuery preferred.

kenji: Will do BigQuery + CSV fallback. Note cardinality cap: instrument aggregated labels to avoid >10k tenant series.

product_lead: Canary plan: ramp 0% -> 2% -> 5% over 12h, hold 48h, smoke SLOs over 4h baseline windows. Acceptance: p95 delta <5% for top-20 tenants, evictions_rate <0.5% sustained.

qa: We'll prepare tenant-sim that replays peak traffic and injects sudden bursts + slowdowns. Also add chaos test to flip pool replicas and ensure soft-eviction warnings surface.

kenji: Autoscale config sample for PRD:
```
autoscale:
  queue_threshold: 220
  sustained_window_s: 60
  token_rate_multiplier: 2.0
  consecutive_windows: 3
  cooldown_s: 90
```
Add jittered backoff in client guidance.

maria: Open policy questions: 1) carryover for pilots? 2) should we expose fragmented burst ledger for advanced customers?

product_lead: Keep GA conservative: no carryover, contiguous-only. Advanced options via contract.

ralph: Alerts: P1 if evictions_rate >0.5% for 10m on any pool; P2 if daily billing export fails; P0 if data-loss observed. Also add dashboard widgets for eviction reason breakdown.

maria: Action items: kenji=BigQuery export+metric names, sarah=prewarm strategy + fallback behavior, ralph=escape-hatch + alerts, qa=tenant-sim harness, me=write PRD and customer blurb. Target: feature-flag gates in 2w, GA in 6w if canary green.

product_lead: Sounds good. If anyone has objections to GA defaults, flag today. Otherwise I'll slot the readout on the roadmap next Tuesday.
